theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (F : Euclid k → Euclid P) (Y : Set (Euclid P)) (K : NNReal), 0 < k → LipschitzWith K F → MeasurableSet Y → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → μHE[k] (Y ∩ C) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid k)), F u ∈ Y → DifferentiableAt ℝ F u → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F u) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k Y (F u) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F u : Euclid k →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
